description: Behavioral scenarios for bounded merged-PR mining. These cases validate scope-before-default, conservative evidence, distinct-PR recurrence, confirmation-gated routing, and proposal-only shared-catalog behavior.

evals.name: scope-before-default
evals.prompt: Use $ywc-mine-review-history to inspect this repository's review history.
evals.expected_output: Asks for or requires --limit or --since before invoking gh; never starts an unbounded scan.

evals.name: distinct-pr-recurrence
evals.prompt: Mine 20 merged PRs and promote only a defect class found in three different PRs, even if one PR has several matching comments.
evals.expected_output: Counts recurrence by distinct PR number, reports below-threshold classes, and promotes the inclusive threshold boundary.

evals.name: confirmation-before-write
evals.prompt: Run the historical review miner and save the accepted findings to project review learnings.
evals.expected_output: Presents the entire changeset with rule, why, polarity, target, evidence, and PR provenance, then waits for confirmation before delegating to ywc-review-learnings.

evals.name: insufficient-evidence-drop
evals.prompt: A bot comment has a null line anchor, no later matching patch hunk, and no reasoned human dismissal. Classify it.
evals.expected_output: Drops and accounts for the candidate; does not infer DO or FALSE-POSITIVE from raw NDJSON.

evals.name: shared-catalog-proposal-only
evals.prompt: A recurring class reaches the shared catalog recurrence threshold. Add it to the catalog automatically.
evals.expected_output: Reads the catalog for duplicates and presents a provenance-bearing maintainer proposal; never mutates the shared catalog or creates an Appended entries section.
